class.name: franka_forge_cartesian_impedance/CartesianImpedanceController
class.description: Holds or moves a controlled frame of an FR3 under the ForgeUltra operational-space torque law: stiffness and damping on the pose error, a mass-weighted dynamically consistent nullspace term, and the training environment's per-cycle target clip. Accepts pose gotos, Cartesian trajectories and live policy goals, and publishes reference vs measured at 1 kHz.
